title: Geo fleet activation epochs and utilization targets 2025-2027
summary: Epoch-based regional provisioning plan for NA / EU / APAC (Jul 2025 - Dec 2027). Focus: staged activation epochs, utilization targets by workload class, warm pool sizing and hard triggers for procurement/commit decisions.
executive_notes: This sheet reframes the usual wave-based plan into discrete activation epochs (short, medium, long) to reduce roll coordination overhead between cloud vendors and to create deterministic procurement checkpoints. Primary goal: maintain 55-70% production steady-state utilization while retaining 20-30% burst capacity for PLG surges and enterprise tails.
assumptions: A100-equivalent baseline (1 A100 v4 unit) used for capacity equivalence calculations
Monthly growth scenario: conservative 12% mo/mo for hosted API traffic; enterprise commitments add staged linear increases per contract
Warm pool: 10% of steady-state baseline for NA/EU, 15% for APAC due to higher latency variance
Model mix shift: 5-8% of requests shift to H100-optimized variants by Q4 2026 (affects kernel selection and throughput)
activation_epochs_description: Short-epoch: 8-12 week windows focused on immediate capacity patches and bugged zones. Medium-epoch: 3-6 month windows coordinating procurement and reserved capacity starts. Long-epoch: 6-12 month windows to onboard new instance families, zone-level fallbacks, and cross-region redistribution. Contingency-epoch: accelerated provisioning if utilization >75% sustained for 3 weeks or enterprise commits exceed forecast by >10%.
utilization_targets: By workload class: PLG-burst routes target 40-55% steady-state (higher acceptable variance), enterprise steady routes target 65-75% steady-state, background batch/embeddings target 70-85% with scheduled windows. Overall fleet target range 55-70% (weighted by token volume).
capacity_triggers: Trigger A: sustained >=72% weighted utilization for 14 days -> activate medium-epoch procurement and enable additional warm pool +10%
Trigger B: any single AZ showing >=85% utilization for 48 hours -> shift routing + enable fallback region lanes
Trigger C: signed enterprise commits >5% of projected baseline -> immediate allocation hold and canary in medium-epoch
Trigger D: model-mix change to >10% H100-class requests -> initiate kernel tuning and reserve H100-backed lanes
cost_and_commit_notes: Estimated incremental committed cost: $0.85/hour per A100-eq reserved (vendor blended). Spot/backfill expected to cover up to 12% of burst needs but cannot be counted toward SLA-backed capacity. Recommend 60% reserved / 28% on-demand / 12% spot mix for NA/EU; APAC tilt to 55/30/15 due to spot availability variance.
slo_and_fallback_mapping: Map customer SLAs to activation epochs: PLG (best-effort) -> short-epoch fallbacks; Tier-1 enterprise -> medium-epoch reserved lanes with cross-region fallback; Compliance/private deployments -> long-epoch pinned capacity with dedicated warmpools. Automated fallback policy: if preferred region latency >150ms  p95 for 10 minutes, route to fallback lane unless enterprise pinning blocks it.
operational_checkpoints: Weekly epoch sync (30m) during active epochs; monthly capacity health report (top-20 routes, p95 latency, token-per-second delta); pre-epoch procurement readout 4 weeks before medium/long epochs. Required docs: cost approval sheet, vendor SLA snapshot, security approval for private SKU lanes.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: vendor SKU shortages (H100) -> mitigation: pre-book in long-epoch windows and qualify A100-quantized fallback. Risk: sudden model shift increases token-inflation -> mitigation: quota throttle knobs and automatic rerouting to cheaper model variants. Risk: APAC network variability -> mitigation: larger warm pools and conservative utilization targets in APAC.
notes_to_self: Keep epoch boundaries loose by 2 weeks to account for vendor lead times. Coordinate with SRE on canary routing for each medium/long epoch. Re-run cost model after Q3 2025 enterprise sales cadence is finalized.
quick_action_items: Action 1: finalize vendor reservation windows for Nov 2025 long-epoch by 2025-07-15
Action 2: sync with Product (hosted-api) to get route-weight forecasts for top-10 PLG routes by 2025-07-01
Action 3: schedule kernel tuning experiment for H100 variants in late Q3 2025
